qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global scale leader in alternative asset management ($1.27T total AUM, $922B fee-earning AUM) with unreplicable 40-year performance track record. High switching costs driven by 10+ year closed-end fund lockups, perpetual capital vehicles ($524B AUM), and 85%+ institutional LP re-up rates. Pricing power demonstrated by maintaining premium ~100-150 bps management fees and 15-20% carry across market cycles with zero fee compression. High returns on capital proved by 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 35%+ (never below 17% in a decade). Primary erosion risks include key-man transition risks, retail redemption runs in semi-liquid structures, and growing competition in private credit.

qualitative.evidence: Total AUM reached $1.27T in FY2025 with $921.7B fee-earning AUM and $523.6B perpetual capital. FY2025 Fee-Related Earnings (FRE) grew to $5.7B ($4.67/share). 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 35.04% and operating ROIC is 40.05%, with FY2025 GAAP ROIC of 35.66%. Free cash flow conversion is exceptional at 114.4% (FY2025 FCF of $4.55B on $3.02B net income). Peak-to-peak earnings compounding confirmed as 2025 Owner EPS ($3.89) eclipsed prior 2019/2022 peaks. Corporate balance sheet maintains an A+ rating with $2.63B in cash, $7.68B in EBIT, and 15.1x interest coverage against $12.58B in long-term fixed-rate senior notes.
